{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 341,
      "where": "4.3.4, alternative notation for a constant object",
      "scan": "$I_E$, où $I_C$",
      "tex": "$I_E$, où $I_C$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$I_E$, ou $I_C$",
      "note": "The printed « où » should be « ou », introducing an alternative notation. The TeX keeps this misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 341,
      "where": "4.3.4, definition of a constant group",
      "scan": "$G_{\\circ E}$, où",
      "tex": "$G_{\\circ E'}$ où",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$G_{\\circ E'}$ où",
        "new": "$G_{\\circ E}$, où"
      },
      "note": "The mark following the group symbol is a text comma, not a prime on E."
    },
    {
      "page": 341,
      "where": "4.3.5, final printed line",
      "scan": "des foncteurs adjoints",
      "tex": "des foncteur adjoints",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "des foncteur adjoints",
        "new": "des foncteurs adjoints"
      },
      "note": "The print has the plural « foncteurs »."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, explanation of the direct-image formula",
      "scan": "où $X$ est un objet de $X$",
      "tex": "où $X$ est un objet de \\sisi{$X$}{$E$}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "où $X$ est un objet de $E$",
      "note": "The second X is a printed typo for E. The TeX corrects it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, definition of the G-action on H_s",
      "scan": "déduites de $F$",
      "tex": "déduites de \\sisi{$F$}{$f$}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "déduites de $f$",
      "note": "The print uses capital F instead of the previously defined morphism f. The TeX corrects it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, reference following the definition of the internal Hom",
      "scan": "défini plus bas (10.     )",
      "tex": "défini plus bas (\\hyperref[IV.subsec10.2]{10.2})",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "(10.2)",
      "note": "The printed reference is left incomplete, with a blank after « 10. ». The TeX silently completes it to 10.2."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, arbitrary limits in the justification for f_!",
      "scan": "aux $\\varinjlim$ quelconques",
      "tex": "aux \\sisi{$\\varinjlim$}{$\\varprojlim$}\nquelconques",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "aux $\\varprojlim$ quelconques",
      "note": "The print has an inductive-limit arrow where projective limits are required. The TeX corrects it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, finite limits in the same parenthesis",
      "scan": "aux $\\varinjlim$ finies",
      "tex": "aux \\sisi{$\\varinjlim$}{$\\varprojlim$} finies",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "aux $\\varprojlim$ finies",
      "note": "This second printed limit arrow likewise points the wrong way. The TeX corrects it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, adjunction immediately before the display defining f_!",
      "scan": "lui-même l'adjoint à gauche d'un foncteur",
      "tex": "lui-même l'adjoint à droite d'un foncteur",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "lui-même l'adjoint à droite d'un foncteur",
      "note": "Here f^* is the right adjoint of f_!. The printed « gauche » is a misprint, silently corrected by the TeX."
    },
    {
      "page": 344,
      "where": "4.5.1, formula for the G-action on H × X",
      "scan": "$g.(h,x)=(hg^{-1},gx)$",
      "tex": "g\\circ (h,x)=(hg^{-1}, gx)",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "g\\circ (h,x)",
        "new": "g\\cdot (h,x)"
      },
      "note": "The print denotes the action by a solid point, not an open circle."
    },
    {
      "page": 345,
      "where": "4.5.1, request to generalize the functorial construction",
      "scan": "le soin de généraliser comportement fonctoriel",
      "tex": "le soin de généraliser ce comportement fonctoriel",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "le soin de généraliser ce comportement fonctoriel",
      "note": "The print omits the determiner before « comportement ». The TeX silently supplies « ce »."
    },
    {
      "page": 345,
      "where": "4.5.2, final variable in the heading",
      "scan": "pour un pro-groupe variable $\\underline{G}$",
      "tex": "pro-groupe variable\n  $G$",
      "kind": "font",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "pro-groupe variable\n  $G$",
        "new": "pro-groupe variable\n  $𝒢$"
      },
      "note": "The final variable is the underlined pro-group symbol, as in the subscript of B and the following text. In the edition's notation this is 𝒢, not the ordinary group G."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "341: 2/1; 342: 0/0; 343: 0/0; 344: 1/6; 345: 1/1 (normal/misprint)."
}
